Executive Summary (Layer 4)

Campaign Overview & Origin

Replay and full GCP live execution (losiern-oase-workshop, scion-hub-oase) of David's venter-scion Immuno-Oncology Cold-to-Hot Tumor Microenvironment (TME) Reprogramming pilot (io-cold-to-hot). The campaign evaluated five innate-immune checkpoint mechanisms (ENPP1, ADAR1, PTPN2, TREX1, LSD1) to convert immunologically "cold" solid tumors into inflamed, \(\text{CD8}^+\) T-cell-infiltrated "hot" tumors responsive to anti-PD-1 therapy, nominating the oral small-molecule ENPP1 inhibitor oase_enpp1_009 and halting cleanly at the Wet-Lab Wall (DEC-003) with a complete, tamper-tested Pre-Wet-Lab Candidate Dossier (WO-008).

Read more →

Work OrderRevisionRoleStageDecision Question
WO-001 r1 hypex-supervisor stage1-intervention-validation Which innate-immune checkpoint mechanism ranks highest across Co-Scientist and Hypex Elo tournaments for cold-to-hot tumor reprogramming?
WO-002 r1 computational-biologist stage1-intervention-validation Does human genetic constraint (gnomAD v4) and GTEx v8 expression support ENPP1 safety while disqualifying TREX1 autoimmunity risk?
WO-003 r1 computational-biologist stage1-intervention-validation Does live 1P AlphaGenome regulatory scoring at the ENPP1 locus (chr6:131894218C>T) reveal any cis-regulatory or chromatin accessibility liabilities?
WO-004 r1 structural-biologist stage2-starting-matter-declaration Does human ENPP1 (P22413) contain a druggable catalytic pocket (fpocket) and does live 1P AlphaFold 3 co-folding support oase_enpp1_009 complex formation?
WO-005 r1 structural-biologist stage2-starting-matter-declaration Does AutoDock Vina physics-based molecular docking corroborate binding of oase_enpp1_009 inside the ENPP1 catalytic groove?
WO-006 r1 medicinal-chemist stage3-candidate-nomination Does BRICS MMP lead optimization (enpp1_hit_001 -> oase_enpp1_009) achieve Rule-of-5 drug-likeness, extracellular polarity, and clean in silico ADMET?
WO-007 r1 admet-dmpk-scientist stage3-candidate-nomination What quantitative 4-assay wet-lab validation package (EXP-01..EXP-04) is required at the Wet-Lab Wall (DEC-003) before advancing oase_enpp1_009 to IND-enabling studies?
WO-008 r1 scientific-reviewer stage3-candidate-nomination Is the ENPP1 clinical competitive landscape favorable and is the Pre-Wet-Lab Candidate Dossier complete and provenance-sealed for oase_enpp1_009 at DEC-003?
